activities.title: Find a resource
activities.implementation_notes: Hub search is server-owned, permission-filtered before ranking, and paginated after ranking. Lexical-v2 weights title, tags, resource type, provider, and description with accent normalization, lightweight lemmatization (including quizzes to quiz), bounded typo tolerance, and partial fallback; it contains no hard-coded conceptual aliases. Hybrid-v1 fuses lexical rank with self-hosted all-minilm:33m semantic candidates stored in pgvector(384), with versioned content hashes, incremental mutation refresh, deployment/dev backfill, an admin status/backfill API, and lexical fallback whenever vectors or Ollama are unavailable. Privacy-safe query fingerprints and result open/save events support zero-result, p95 latency, click-through, Recall@10, nDCG@10, and MRR evaluation.

source.title: Search and filter resources

acceptance.criterion: Learners can search resource title, description, or provider and refine results by type, tag, access, and provider.
acceptance.notes: BOT-115 tests cover lexical-v2 weighted fields, lemmatization, accents, typo tolerance, partial fallback, privacy-safe hybrid RRF, permission-before-ranking, stable pagination, and committed Recall@10/nDCG@10/MRR metrics. A real disposable Postgres smoke test verified pgvector 0.8.2, vector(384), the HNSW cosine index, seven embedded documents, and personality quiz ranking the 16Personalities assessment first without conceptual alias mappings.

acceptance.criterion: Resources suggested through Hub Ask follow the same organization, channel, and learner-group visibility rules as deterministic discovery.
acceptance.notes: BOT-115 service regression proves inaccessible exact-title candidates are removed before lexical ranking and pagination; focused Search and Hub advisor permission tests also pass.

acceptance.criterion: A submitted resource search appears as a compact inline response object whose See more action expands and refines the same object in place.
acceptance.notes: Hub search regression covers inferred submitted searches and singular/plural matching; production build verifies the compact and expanded responsive response object.

acceptance.criterion: The compact result row remains visible above the selected resource detail workspace and replaces any redundant second resource switcher.
acceptance.notes: Focused TypeScript/ESLint, Hub interaction and routing regressions, and the production build verify the compact result row directly controls the existing detail workspace without a duplicate switcher.

acceptance.criterion: A submitted resource search occupies the assistant turn in conversation order, selects its first result by default, and preserves valid alternating history for the learner's next follow-up.
acceptance.notes: Hub interaction regression proves the learner search plus assistant search-component event becomes valid alternating advisor history; TypeScript, focused ESLint, routing tests, and the production build passed.

activities.title: Keep a resource in the Library
activities.implementation_notes: A UserSavedResource is the learner's Library membership. Opening, adding to a custom List, writing Notes or attaching media, reviewing, or explicitly saving a resource can establish membership without requiring a default List. Passive suggestion, selection, display, and expansion do not save it. The Hub detail and Library row action menus expose explicit add/remove Library and List actions; later engagement updates preserve custom List membership.
